description: Source code for the DeviceModelCatalog utility that provides device presentation details, including name and symbol, based on device identifiers and device families. It loads device mappings from resource JSON files and provides methods to retrieve device information.

classes.name: DevicePresentation
classes.description: A struct representing the display title and symbol for a device.

methods.name: DeviceModelCatalog.presentation
methods.description: Generates a DevicePresentation object that includes the device title and symbol based on deviceFamily and modelIdentifier inputs.

methods.name: DeviceModelCatalog.symbol
methods.description: Determines the appropriate symbol string for a device based on device family and model identifier.

methods.name: DeviceModelCatalog.loadMapping
methods.description: Loads device identifier to name mappings from a JSON resource file.

methods.name: DeviceModelCatalog.locateResourceBundle
methods.description: Locates the resource bundle containing device identifier JSON files.

methods.name: DeviceModelCatalog.bundleIfContainsDeviceModels
methods.description: Checks if a given bundle contains the required device identifier JSON resources.
